title: Visit to Drew's house and his needle-and-Teflon setup; wife Janessa links the forces

tellings.quote: So, we go to Drew's house. I take my wife and we spent, you know, four or five hours looking at his setup, looking what he's doing.

plain: Charles Buer, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a NASA chief, says that around 2016 he and his wife Janessa visited the Florida home of a man named Andrew Arjima, called Drew. He says they spent four or five hours studying Drew's experimental setup of a needle and Teflon, and that his wife made the link between the forces involved. He tells it as part of a story about building a kind of propulsion that works against gravity.
